name: Shoebill stork
fact: A shoebill stands about 1.2 m tall and can stay motionless for hours waiting for lungfish.

name: Pink fairy armadillo
fact: The smallest armadillo: about 12 cm long and 5 cm tall. It lives in the sandy plains of central Argentina.

name: Okapi
fact: The giraffe's only living relative stands about 1.5 m at the shoulder and 1.9 m to the top of its head.

name: Moai statue
fact: The average Easter Island moai is about 4 m tall and weighs 12 tonnes. The tallest ever erected is nearly 10 m.

name: Zamboni ice resurfacer
fact: A full-size Zamboni is about 2.2 m tall, 4.5 m long, and tops out at 15 km/h.

name: Dodo
fact: The dodo stood about 1 m tall and weighed 10–18 kg. The last one was seen in 1662.

name: Trebuchet
fact: A large medieval counterweight trebuchet stood around 12 m tall and could hurl a 90 kg stone 300 m.

name: Tardigrade
fact: Tardigrades are about 0.5 mm long and 0.3 mm tall. They survive vacuum, radiation, and being frozen for decades.
